items.text:
It's good good potential (like a lot of early access titles) the core loop is OK but very grindy with a lack of the sort of impactful variety of objects.  

Good: 
There are some commendable mechanics, ie battery powered tools, rechargers.
There is a good amount of build flexiblity if you like squares.
A good variety of textures to theme your ship the way you like.
An intriguing mission system that seems to have good variety on the surface at least.
The docking minigame is a fun feature.

Bad:
The procedurally generated ships are often nonsensically so.  
Combat is weird with all the pausing and unclear action/reaction stuff going on.
There isn't a lot of component level variety that has any real impact on the finished product.
Where you can/should sell each item is really unclear so you wind up walking around a lot to find someone to buy things.
The uninstall is boring slow/tedious.
Once you get an EVA suit the O2/Power limitation becomes non-existant making it just a grind fest of collection.

Ugly:
Current bug that I've hit (now on 3rd playthru try to avoid) - I get a warrant, get arrested either pay 15k or lose 3 years of life in prision.  If you are captured out in space you lose your entire ship and stuff.  The warrant seems to randomly come back (sometimes immediately) requiring another 15k or 3 years.  It's aggravating as you don't have any clue as to why you are "wanted" all the sudden.  Super frustrating and ultimately why I'm done playing for a spell until they are farther along.
items.text_zh:
它很好，潜力很大（像很多抢先体验游戏一样），核心循环还行，但非常肝，缺乏那种有影响力的物品多样性。

好：
有一些值得称赞的机制，比如电池供电的工具、充电器。
如果你喜欢方块，有很好的建造灵活性。
有各种各样的纹理，可以按你喜欢的方式为你的飞船设定主题。
一个有趣的任務系统，至少表面上看起来有很好的多样性。
对接小游戏是个有趣的功能。

坏：
程序生成的飞船往往毫无道理。
战斗很奇怪，有各种暂停和不清楚的动作/反应。
没有很多组件级别的多样性对最终产品有真正的影响。
在哪里可以/应该出售每件物品真的很不清楚，所以你最终会走来走去寻找买家。
卸载无聊、缓慢/繁琐。
一旦你得到EVA服，O2/电力限制就变得不存在了，使其只是收集的肝。

丑：
我遇到的当前bug（现在第三次游玩尝试避免）——我得到逮捕令，被逮捕，要么支付15k，要么在监狱里失去3年生命。如果你在太空中被捕获，你会失去整艘飞船和东西。逮捕令似乎会随机回来（有时立即），需要再支付15k或3年。这很恼人，因为你完全不知道你为什么突然被“通缉”。超级令人沮丧，最终也是我暂时停止玩的原因，直到他们进展更远。
